procedure: Read current and pinned original differences; inspect actual production callers and existing fixture source. No build or test run and no product edits.

findings.finding: Preserve atomic event-map operations; take-event CAS loop can be replaced with an InterlockedAnd of the complemented mask, returning whether any selected bit existed in the returned old value.
findings.counter_review: Both linearize consumption at one atomic operation; unrelated bits survive, concurrent same-bit raises before consumption coalesce and those after it survive. Existing early FALSE may linearize at its snapshot; atomic AND may linearize later without changing the contract. This does not turn the bit map into a counted-event queue.
findings.change_plan: Replace only c_cpu_take_event body with old-value mask test around InterlockedAnd; retain snapshot/raise/clear semantics and all consumer ordering. Recommendation only.
findings.callers: HALT SIGALRM; normal RESET/SIGALRM/SAD/IRQ; protected STI IRQ; restored-context RESET.
findings.verification: test/observation/verify-ccpu-notification.ps1 extracts actual production helpers. Existing fixture exercises separate concurrent raises but waits for both before consumption: add concurrent raise/consume controls and same-bit before/after ordering when implementing.

findings.finding: Debug and IRQ helper entries are production-connected, not unused hardware-V86 remnants.
findings.missing_evidence: Complete protected exception resume/RF/debug pending/IRQ ordering comparison against original CPU operations and actual context switching. No conclusion that all monitor semantics are justified.

findings.finding: Wake carrier retains wake until HALT waits; worker creates it at begin and closes at cleanup. Startup and shutdown comments alone do not prove all producers have stopped.
findings.missing_evidence: host_applClose calls nt_remove_event_thread and TerminateHeartBeat, but TerminateHeartBeat waits 10000ms without inspecting result (and skips wait on same thread). Need prove all paths reaching worker wait_end have stopped producers, or identify minimal existing lifetime-owner repair. No claim of proven use-after-close; no new timeout or retry authorized.

findings.finding: Mixed diff contains substantive signed ica_intack rejection guard and shared IRQ dispatch as well as an excluded non-NTVDM branch. Must not drop the entire diff merely because it contains #error.
findings.missing_evidence: Finish PIC rejection contract and shared tail equivalence; register separately from exclusions.

findings.finding: ccpu386ThrdExptnPtr returns jmp_buf pointer; dereferencing supplies the array object required by setjmp. Same correction applies to simulation frame.
findings.counter_review: Provider can return NULL on BADID or absent TLS; retaining correct setjmp type does not prove failure handling. Null-frame policy belongs to provider/consumer contract and remains unresolved.

findings.finding: Instruction trace hooks include fixed selector/IP filters and are gated by MVDM_CCPU_DECODE_DIAGNOSTICS; not CPU execution semantics.
findings.change_plan: Remove entire instruction diagnostic block and its sole-use termination header/comment at 245-249; reconcile diagnostic providers and diagnostic build selector uses before deleting shared definitions. Preserve original instruction dispatch.
findings.verification: Selected product preprocessed tokens and compiled image comparison; remove or adapt diagnostic-only fixture assumptions rather than delete runtime coverage.

findings.finding: Production task exchange calls restore-debug-context under lock; it defers exception delivery to NEXT_INST. Fixture tests breakpoint-before-execution, pending trap, RF suppression, no breakpoint, and RESET priority.
findings.missing_evidence: Full context switch and exceptional unwind semantics across real WOW task scheduling, including pending latch cancellation at c_cpu_continue. Existing fixture source is not a new passing run.

findings.finding: Saved frame pointer lets abnormal SEH unwind retire only its own top simulation frame; normal FE path already pops and must not pop its parent twice.
findings.change_plan: Keep same frame identity through setjmp and finally; do not replace with unconditional level decrement or global reset. Track NULL-return provider contract separately.
findings.verification: Ordinary nested FE, abnormal callback abort, parent resume and preserved last error. No fresh execution.

remaining: Complete per-opcode classifications including mixed exclusions; do not mistake inventory for completed file.
Reconcile original conditional boundaries and diagnostic lines separately from runtime changes.
Write complete sorted register rows only after whole-file necessity classification; then advance file-order/count.
